title: The Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
description: The software development lifecycle end to end: requirements, design, building, testing, shipping, and keeping a system alive afterward.

changelog.notes: Initial release — 34 decks, 177 cards, each pack with a preview card teaching the concept before its graded main card and practice cards.
One practice question said "both strategies" without naming them; it now names canary and blue-green releases.
Adds Learn more articles (10, each with a worked example) for the glossary terms; tapping a term now offers "Read the full explanation".
Removes the Wikipedia links from glossary terms that have a Learn more article; the article is now the single place to read more.
Rewrites the Learn more articles in a warmer, teacher-to-student voice; no change to the content or the glossary.
